Real failed Tags transaction rollback preserves the entire original collection and cannot provide intent.
Same native committed payload is retained after later write/account ABA/closed-and-reopened Realm.
Copied branded intent is structurally equal but not runtime identity; absent WHOLE receipt is passed as undefined with existing global baseline.
Post-commit Realm replacement occurs while actual receipt waits behind an owned production session.
A cloned originating baseline still allows the actual local mutation but yields no branded intent.
strongerObservables: Zero total HTTP before initial rejection and after original receipt replay, including no read/enroll/repair.
Full committed local image and entire KeeperApp unchanged; independent retained recovery records remain.
Actual signed remote snapshot tuple and all encrypted records are unchanged and decrypt to the complete original baseline.
Rejected Delete never becomes a tombstone or changes saved consent.
